description: Main route component for the QwikNotes app, managing state, fetching notes, and rendering child components for note list, viewer, editor, and header.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Defines a Qwik component that manages state and UI logic for notes.

methods.name: useVisibleTask$
methods.description: Runs a side-effect task when the component becomes visible, e.g., fetch notes.
Wraps event handler functions to be serializable and compatible with Qwik's reactive system.
